content.text:
- **High — must fix:** Aborted/error runs can export a prior turn’s reply. [`useKeatingAgent.tsx:881`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:881) scans the entire transcript for the last user and assistant messages. If a run ends before producing an assistant message, it pairs the current prompt with the previous assistant reply, violating the “current turn only; no prior turns” contract. Track content within the active run or require the assistant message to follow the current user message.

- **High — must fix:** Revoked consent can be bypassed by a late failed request. [`arize-observability.ts:49`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/arize-observability.ts:49) captures `preferenceEnabled=true`; if `turnOff()` runs while fetch is pending, the later catch restores the content-bearing payload and exposes a retry that resubmits using the stale `true` value. Add an epoch/abort guard and re-read current consent before retaining or retrying any payload.

- **High — must fix:** The rate limit is caller-spoofable and its memory is unbounded. [`traces.ts:16`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/server/api/observability/v1/arize/traces.ts:16) trusts the first `X-Forwarded-For` value, while [`arize-observability.ts:197`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/server/utils/arize-observability.ts:197) never evicts source keys. A direct client can rotate XFF values to bypass limits and grow the map indefinitely. Use a trusted-proxy-derived address and cap/expire the map.

- **High — must fix:** Exported OTel spans have near-zero real durations. Web spans are started and immediately ended at export in [`arize-observability.ts:168`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/server/utils/arize-observability.ts:168); root evaluator/provider spans do the same in [`arize.ts:61`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/observability/arize.ts:61) and [`arize.ts:80`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/observability/arize.ts:80). `keating.duration_ms` attributes do not repair the OTel timestamps used by Arize waterfalls and latency views. Supply `startTime`/end times; the web envelope also needs child offsets if generation/tool placement matters.

- **High — must fix:** The consent copy describes a one-turn choice, but the toggle is persistent. [`KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:572`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:572) says “Share this turn” and “for this turn,” while [`analytics-preferences.ts:54`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/analytics-preferences.ts:54) stores the preference in localStorage and every future run consults it. Either make consent one-shot or clearly say it shares future turns until disabled.

- **Medium — must fix before broad provider rollout:** The relay rejects valid model identifiers. [`arize-observability.ts:11`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/server/utils/arize-observability.ts:11) excludes `/` and `:`, but Keating supports identifiers such as `anthropic/claude-sonnet` and Bedrock IDs ending in `:0`. Those turns receive 400 responses and enter retry recovery. Use a separate bounded schema for provider/model values and test representative IDs.

- **Medium:** Failure recovery is normally invisible. Status is emitted only as a transient window event at [`useKeatingAgent.tsx:268`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:268), but Settings returns `null` while closed, so [`KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:136`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/KeatingUiSettingsTab.tsx:136) misses failures that occur during ordinary chat. Also, the recovery “Turn off” action changes localStorage without updating the mounted toggle state. Keep status in shared state or expose a client snapshot/subscription.

- **Medium:** Root observations mislabel Pi and MCP executions as CLI and omit most error outcomes. [`project.ts:90`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/project.ts:90) has no surface input and hardcodes `surface: "cli"`; benchmark, policy evolution, prompt evaluation, and auto-improve only observe their success tails, so unexpected errors and auto-improve cooldown rejection produce no corresponding evaluator span. Pass surface context and wrap each complete operation with success/error/rejected observation.

- **Medium:** JSON parse telemetry is incorrect. [`pi-agent.ts:85`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/pi-agent.ts:85) records provider success as `pending`, while actual parsing happens later at [`pi-agent.ts:113`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/pi-agent.ts:113) without observation. Conversely, any provider/network failure in JSON mode is labeled `invalid` even though parsing never occurred. Observe the combined completion-and-parse boundary or emit a distinct parse result.

- **Medium:** Provider shutdown is skipped when `forceFlush()` throws. This occurs in [`arize.ts:65`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/observability/arize.ts:65), [`arize.ts:93`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/observability/arize.ts:93), and [`arize-observability.ts:179`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/server/utils/arize-observability.ts:179). Repeated collector failures can leak short-lived provider/exporter resources. Put shutdown in `finally`.

- **Medium — test blind spot:** [`arize-observability.test.ts:5`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/test/arize-observability.test.ts:5) tests configuration and an isolated exporter only; it never invokes instrumented project/provider operations. [`arize-server-observability.test.ts:57`](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/arize-server-observability.test.ts:57) tests pure helpers rather than HTTP origin/body/rate-limit behavior or actual `ReadableSpan` timestamps. Add operation-level isolation tests, handler-level requests, supported model-ID fixtures, abort-with-prior-turn content, and consent-revocation-during-flight coverage.
